title: The Vanished Clownfish Pendant
intro: A silver clownfish pendant has disappeared from the glass case at the aquarium gift shop just before closing time.

suspects.name: Wren
suspects.line: I was just sitting on the bench reading.

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: Sharks are my favorite, not shiny fish.

suspects.name: Tobias
suspects.line: I was looking at the octopus tank the whole time.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: Ask the cashier, she saw everything.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I only came in for a postcard, I promise!

clues.text: The ticket desk camera shows the culprit was not here at closing time. The clerk swears this spot stayed empty all evening.
A sticky popcorn trail was found near the case, but it does not match the culprit's shoes. Whoever left those sticky footprints was someone else entirely.
Muddy bicycle tracks lead straight to this rack, so the culprit definitely came by bike. Someone pedaled in with a plan.
The culprit is not the one who was seen at the octopus tank. The octopus was too busy sulking to notice anyone lingering there.
